name: Enterprise Software System and Entitlement Binding

constraintRules.text: Vendor Product, operator Software System, Business Application, Deployment and Runtime Environment remain separate masters.
Entitlement constraints are non-executable while Purchased Licence / Entitlement is unallocated and its relations are unapproved.
ApplicationUsage may cite entitlementAllocationRef as optional evidence and remains valid without it.
Hosted usage may have entitlement evidence while deploymentOccurrenceRefs and runtimeEnvironmentRefs remain empty.
Agreement and surviving obligation semantics remain outside the entitlement aggregate.
Derived installation is never a minted identity and requires an approved WM-SFT-009/010 currency join.
No Product, System, Application, Deployment, Runtime, Usage or Entitlement identifier is reused across master boundaries.

holds: WM-SFT-002 reservation row amendment and N4 split remain pending.
WM-SFT-010 specification and installation currency join remain missing.
Purchased Licence / Entitlement is identifier-unassigned; PB-02 through PB-05 do not authorize executable relations.
WM-ECO-006 and WM-XCT-029 scope fit remains unverified.
No external framework conformance, canonical completeness or installability is claimed.
